title: Catching up in O(new) rather than O(history)
note: The third quadratic path this repository has recorded, and the ways of putting it back. Every reducer re-reads the log before it decides -- that is what stops a decision being made against a stale projection -- and doing it with a full read made each governed operation cost the whole history. N1, N2 and N4 remove the anchored path or the bookkeeping that keeps it cheap; each is invisible to every correctness test and shows up only as a count of full reads that grows with the work done. N5-N7 attack the correctness the shortcut must not buy: a record folded twice, a tail trusted without verification, an anchor followed into bytes it no longer describes. N8 attacks the fast digest predicate, which is exactly where a subtle widening hides after a hot function is rewritten.

mutations.name: N1_the_scheduler_reads_the_whole_history_every_time
mutations.rationale: every governed operation costs the whole log again; nothing is wrong with any single operation, which is exactly why it survived undetected before

mutations.name: N2_the_store_reads_the_whole_history_every_time
mutations.rationale: the same, on the authority projection

mutations.name: N4_advance_never_moves_its_anchor_forward
mutations.rationale: the records come back and the position does not, so the next call re-reads the same tail and the one after that reads a longer one

mutations.name: N8_the_fast_digest_predicate_accepts_uppercase
mutations.rationale: one logical digest gains two spellings, so a set of digests contains duplicates that compare unequal -- the widening that hides when a hot predicate is rewritten for speed

mutations.name: N9_the_fast_digest_predicate_allows_a_trailing_newline
mutations.rationale: $ matches before a final newline in Python, which is the classic way a regex rewrite of a character check quietly changes what it accepts

mutations.name: N10_a_fresh_load_stops_verifying_the_prefix
mutations.rationale: the anchored path trusts the prefix, and that is only acceptable because a process starting fresh checks the whole chain; without that nothing ever verifies the beginning
